evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies wallet transaction accounting and RPCs in src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp and src/wallet/receive.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a long-standing accounting defect where mixed-input transactions such as CoinJoins and Payjoins produced fabricated recipient entries and nonsensical or negative fee calculations in history RPCs. Resolves issue #14136 open since 2018, providing durable and substantial correctness improvements to wallet history accounting after rescans and descriptor imports.
